title: GOP convention featuring battleground candidates. Will it backfire?
shortDescription: The convention program released by the Republican National Committee includes Senate candidates in Michigan, Ohio, North Carolina, Georgia and Texas.

title: Republicans take a big election risk with 'Trumpapalooza' convention
shortDescription: Trump is putting himself center stage in the midterms with a Dallas convention, even as his low approval rating threatens to drag down GOP candidates.

title: Trump's super PAC MAGA Inc. shells out $10M to Texas' Ken Paxton
shortDescription: MAGA Inc., the pro-Trump super PAC, has issued $10 million to help Ken Paxton, who's battling James Talarico in a tough U.S. Senate campaign in Texas.

title: Trump super PAC to spend up to $500M
shortDescription: President Donald Trump says he'll spend as much as $500 million to help Republican candidates win midterm election races in 2026.

title: Trump targets wolf protections to help ranchers
shortDescription: Trump signed an executive order directing a review of federal wolf protections to help ranchers protect livestock and lower beef prices.

title: US and Iran trade fire again after Trump downplays severity of the war
shortDescription: U.S. forces struck three Iranian crude oil carriers after Iran launched ballistic missiles at two Navy warships. No American personnel were injured.

title: Judge reinforces order barring groundbreaking on Trump’s 250-foot arch

title: Donald Trump's enovys to meet with Putin for talks on the Ukraine war
shortDescription: U.S. special representatives Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will also visit Kyiv in an effort to reignite diplomatic efforts to end the Ukraine war

title: Missouri asks Supreme Court to save GOP map
